title: Impact of Rehabilitation Therapy Using Strength and Blood Flow Restriction Training on Muscular Fitness and Regeneration After Elective Hip Replacement
official: Clinical Randomized Trial of the Influence of Rehabilitation Therapy Using Strength and Blood Flow Restriction Training on Muscular Fitness and Regeneration After Elective Hip Replacement
summary: In the present project, the framework conditions of outpatient rehabilitation at the Bonn Center for Outpatient Rehabilitation will now be used to prove whether sports science-controlled strength and BFR training has a similar effect in the postoperative rehabilitation phase. Strength and BFR training in medical training therapy complements daily exercise therapy in order to ensure implementation in the guideline-based rehabilitation process. . The interventions are carried out as part of the exercise therapy units in outpatient rehabilitation ETM01 following the RTS hip and knee TEP basis KTL 2020.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ability for Rehabilitation
* Total Hip Arthroplasty Surgery during the last 4 Weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* Sickle Cell Anemia
* Iatrogenic changes in the vessels of the lower Extremity (e.g. Stents)
* Open Wounds or Infections of the lower Extremity
